name: How long does it take to install shower grab bars?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install shower grab bars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing one to two shower grab bars typically takes one to two hours when working on an existing finished bathroom wall. The project length depends on the wall material; dense porcelain or natural marble takes longer to drill carefully than fiberglass or drywall. If your accessibility project is part of a broader bathroom renovation or requires opening drywall to install custom wood blocking, framing, and tile patching, the work will take longer and follow the larger remodel schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Retrofitting one or two bars on existing walls usually takes one to two hours. Dense tile or custom wall blocking during a remodel will extend the timeframe.
